counterPressure.note: One low might line and a narrow ferocity roll are the entire raw-stat case for this blade. Its whole reason to exist is what rises where it kills, not what it hits harder than a plain chainsaw.

entries.name: Furnace of Hunger

counterPressure.note: One low vitality line and a narrow regeneration roll are all the plate offers as armour. Every point of ordinary durability the pool could have put here instead went to the toll it levies on the field.

entries.notes: OFF-ROLE ON PURPOSE. atom.econ-toll's pool eligibility (g.economy) is girdle/jewel-major/jewel-minor only; core-guard is not in it. A unique's fixed core is never drawn from the pool, so the role tag never applies to it (ssot-uniques.md §3.5 rung 2) — a chestplate that tithes the field is exactly the verb the pool would never hand to a torso.

entries.name: Smothering Shell

counterPressure.note: One low shield-toughness line and a narrow shield-capacity roll leave it barely sturdier than a plain scale piece. What it does instead is answer every hit that lands on it.

entries.notes: OFF-ROLE ON PURPOSE. atom.retribution's pool eligibility (g.on-hit) does not include ward-array. A unique's fixed core bypasses the pool tag entirely (ssot-uniques.md §3.5 rung 2) — a shoulder-guard that answers every hit is the verb no rolled shoulder piece can ever offer.

counterPressure.note: One low vitality line and a narrow evasion roll are the whole stat sheet. The ward it raises on spawn is the entire reason to carry a manhole cover into a fight that never stops arriving.

entries.name: Claw of the Hive

counterPressure.note: One low might line and a narrow precision roll are the whole raw-stat case. The claws are for digging graves in the swarm's wake, not for hitting harder than a plain glove.

entries.name: Massed Hamper

counterPressure.note: One low stoicism line and a narrow regeneration roll are all the pack offers as protection. It pays for itself off the field it crosses, not off its own plating.
